campaign: Hatchet-derived process control: gate wall, selection coverage, lane overlap and governed promotion on existing Go owners
doctrine: Work and commit only in the overgo_hatchet worktree; do not push. Owner priorities 2026-09-09, judged by the phase wall table every gate prints: (1) safe selection and evidence reuse, since the last gate ran 234 packages with zero receipt reuse; (2) fast failure before expensive work, on master's a20ce59e ordering (vet and build before acceptance, edited owners first); (3) measured concurrency that shares GPU capacity between correctness workloads, changed packages first, overlap evaluated without recreating contention; (4) automatic mechanical repairs that refresh derived files before the candidate freezes, preserve reviewed thresholds and bind verification to the resulting candidate. The lane is judged by fewer unnecessary executions, faster failure detection and shorter successful gates with the same regression detection; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused. Master's reviewed intake (74e8ea80, cbb2a24d, 89deb42c, a20ce59e) is the design authority: the full gate stays mandatory for every commit, no denominator shrinks, no skipped check earns credit, semantic literal authority stays as master decided, and the lane re-lands none of what master excluded without an independently bound correctness test and a measured validation benefit. No Hatchet source is copied; concepts are ported onto existing Go owners. Every row lands with one acceptance test in the owning package, named in its file-guarded verify, and commits through the plan-bound gate. Host rows land first; the measured rows precede master's batch-promotion row, which alone completes validation-batch-control; lane rows master's intake declined stay last and are re-planned before dispatch; master's retained rows are assigned to master and never dispatch here. Master's 2ef953fa is the device admission authority: the gate's shared lease per host test batch, the measurement children that wait under their parent deadline and processcontrol.AwaitResource are reused, never duplicated; the lane adds no second wait loop and no refusal of foreign holders. One package-graph fact names the packages that need the device, and selection, batch order, the device lane and the lane exclusion resolver read it. Each lane cycle lands a plan-only commit, so plan-only commits are measured as their own gate shape. Owner review of 2026-09-10: routine re-planning rides in the next implementation commit's plan path, so a lane cycle lands one commit; only a merge lands a plan-only commit. Measurement admission is fixed before any further concurrency: correctness tests run under a shared lease, measurement tests run outside it, and the parent/child interaction is tested with a synthetic resource. A scheduling row claims a speedup only from the phase wall tables before and after it, showing fewer executed checks and a shorter total gate wall. Safe subprocess and file dependency classification with evidence reuse leads the lane. Master's plan of 2026-09-10 (263e89be) stabilizes the evidence-commit workflow first: one gate store retained through evidence and finalization, then evidence-commit recovery without repeated acquisition, and it keeps gate scheduling repairs with this lane. The lane mirrors that item under master's ownership, lands nothing that touches the gate store's lifetime until master's store-lifetime step is merged, and builds the lane overlap's store-writer admission on master's retained store handle. The selection-safety commit 87d84843 closed the unsafe classifications master's replan named. Master's own plan-only re-plans are master's; this lane's re-plans ride in its implementation commits.

items.title: End lane servers with the run

steps.title: End lane servers with the run and report their device release in the run receipt
steps.rationale: Master's 2ef953fa owns device admission: shared batches wait, measurement children wait under their parent deadline, and device tasks report not_busy only after the process tree exits. The lane keeps the one remaining hole: a browser lane that fails leaves overgo-server holding the device until an operator kills it, and the next gate's shared lease then waits its whole budget. The lane server is a supervised child of the lane run, ends with the run's terminal receipt on every exit path, and the receipt records the device release. No refusal of foreign holders and no second admission path. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

items.title: Make a lane merge one command and one gate

steps.title: Teach plan -prepare-merge the first-parent-target lane case end to end
steps.rationale: The merge of 2ef953fa took a manual sequence the lane repeats every cycle: stash the candidate, merge with no commit, keep the lane plan, resolve the census files, republish the census, import master's closure decisions, rebind, add and assign the merge row, and only then gate. plan -prepare-merge learns the first-parent-target lane case end to end: it performs that sequence, refuses when several worktrees sit on master's commit only if the projection cannot be resolved, and leaves one gate to run. Measured by the wall from the merge request to the merge gate start. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

steps.title: Derive the audio reference store and data roots from the lane's declared roots instead of the operator's environment
steps.rationale: Two of the lane's gate attempts failed only because OVERGO_AUDIO_REFERENCE_STORE was not exported: the audio parity acceptances derive their datasets and model roots from the reference store's parent directory, and the gate exports the lane store when the variable is unset, which names roots the lane does not have. The gate derives the reference store from the declared data roots (local-models.json) the same way the tests derive theirs, records the derivation in the environment evidence, and the tests read the declared roots instead of the store's parent. No operator environment is needed for a lane gate. items.title: Stabilize evidence commits; defer broader control policy until model evidence

steps.title: Recover one evidence commit without repeated acquisition or manual debt repair
steps.rationale:
First repair split at its ownership boundary: store-lifetime retains the admission handle and tests transaction contention. This parent still owns cancellable startup admission, supervision/restart and the full evidence-to-commit proof; the child is not completion of this acceptance. Normal parallel-writer contention waits for OS release, without a new arbitrary timeout or treating busy as a failed model/check. Preserve caller cancellation and explicit operation budgets across retries. First bounded stabilization slice. Reproduce the E4B evidence-only commit failure in an isolated clone/store, using a counted acquisition stub and complete immutable evidence. Inventory existing gate admission, command supervision, transaction retry, receipt publication and reconcile/finalization callers before editing. Reuse their owners; remove any duplicated policy or forwarding wrapper displaced by the repair in the same change. Keep the runnable model producer and inference surface unchanged wherever dependency independence permits; a shared-runtime change requires affected readmission.

Implement TestEvidenceCommitRecoveryAcceptance in internal/gate/evidence_commit_recovery_test.go; its absence is an implementation obligation, never a pass. Inject live database contention before test-receipt publication, process interruption before/after receipt persistence, supervisor restart, and failure between commit and final record. After the contention is released, the existing supervisor/gate path must reach one terminal result within the original declared deadline: acquisition count remains one, valid completed checks are reused, every uncompleted check still runs, exactly one commit/plan advancement occurs, recording debt is reconciled and resources release. Persist the attempt so restart requires no manual reconstruction. Prove that changed candidate/environment, foreign live ownership, corrupt/mismatched debt and exhausted deadline refuse with durable diagnostics and unchanged foreign state. No user status prompt should be needed to notice or resume a failed attempt.

Use existing cmd/gate, internal/gate, processcontrol, runrecord and OvergoDB contracts. Add no recovery command, daemon, scheduler, alternate receipt format or generic facade. Split at a concrete failing boundary if needed; each repair retains full required gates and the parent remains open until end-to-end acceptance. Record old/new caller ownership, removed wrappers/policy copies, exact executed/reused check counts, zero duplicate acquisition, terminal resource state and operator interventions. Once this bounded path passes, return to model evidence; broad batching adoption stays in batch-promotion.

steps.title: Promote batching only after recovery, safe selection and measured payback
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestPreflightReportsValidateFindings|TestPreflightSeparatesSkippedChecks|TestPreflightNeverRepairsStore|TestPreflightRejectsCombinedInspection|TestGateStartIndexAdoptsStatRefreshUnderSameTree|TestGateStartIndexRefusesAndPreservesLaterUnplannedStaging)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestCheckpointPersistenceSurvivesKill|TestCheckpointMemoCoversEveryCommand|TestChangeSelectiveVerificationShadow|TestBatchedGateCostEvidence)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestIndependentPackageEvidenceAcceptance|TestGovernedBatchDeclarationAcceptance|TestProjectedMergePreflightBeforeVerification|TestGateReusesUnchangedCheckEvidence|TestPackageSelectiveReuse)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/batch_promotion_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchPromotionControl$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestReusedCheckpointCompletionAuthorityAcceptance$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^(TestDocsHoldNoUnplannedBinaries|TestDocsInventoryPolicy)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestPreflightRejectsUnplannedDocsBeforeStore$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestChangeSelectionUnownedRuntimeInputs$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestBatchFlush' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestCandidateGoPhasesExcludeIgnoredSource$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchEvidence' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestChangedPackageFailurePreventsBroadSweep|TestModernGoPreflightBindsCandidateCensus|TestStaticFailurePreventsAcceptance|TestGateRunsStaticChecksBeforeAcceptance|TestCheckpointEvidenceReuseAcrossRuns|TestPackageSelectiveReuse|TestTerminalEvidenceRestart)$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Existing checkpoint memo, independent package receipts, transaction recovery, shared GPU admission, input preflight, candidate isolation and terminal-obligation owners are lower bounds, not features to rebuild. Retain every existing verifier, checkpoint and escalation obligation. The new evidence-commit-recovery prerequisite owns immediate reliability repair; this row owns later policy integration. Broad concurrency, automatic scheduling and reduced gates remain deferred until this row proves safe adoption after the modality report.

Selection must follow actual compiled dependencies, fixtures, runtime files, subprocesses, renames/deletions, build tags, toolchain, device mode and resolved environment. Unknown reach broadens verification, including required fixture/device tests; it does not justify a short-only downgrade. Before adopting Hatchet classification, add counterexamples for os.Args[1], reassignment and shadowing, aliased os/exec imports, caller-supplied paths, indirect launchers, command argument construction, embedded inputs and repository-level fixtures. Use binding-aware analysis or conservative fallback; textual identifier names, one safe assignment, file extensions and package-wide caller annotations cannot establish independence. Shadow-compare the complete historical/injected-failure matrix against the current full gate: no omitted required checks, missed seeded regression or stale receipt. Policy changes cannot validate themselves using their proposed reduced scope.

Persist each terminal package success independently as it finishes, even if a sibling fails, skips or is killed. Reuse requires exact input/environment/contract identities; a failed write retries receipt publication, not acquisition. Retain cumulative obligations across kill/restart, replan, scope expansion and branch changes. Never credit skipped, unavailable, unfinished or zero-match tests; acquire required fixtures and distinguish explicit unsupported-platform exclusions. Scratch retry files remain projections of OvergoDB authority. Include interrupted replacement of gate_cache.json and independent successful packages beside failed/unavailable siblings.

Prepare mechanical derived authorities before freezing the candidate, then run cheap deterministic refusals before expensive acceptance and packages. Bind both baseline and published census to the staged candidate. Preserve the same resolved dataset roots between acceptance and package tests. Mechanical preparation may regenerate manifests/censuses from existing reviewed policy; it cannot change semantic literal exceptions, floors or adjudication. Recompute candidate identity after preparation; reject later drift. Keep preflight read-only and nonpromoting. Repeat deterministic evidence assertions without silently repeating independent model acquisition; preserve compound-command coverage and every required repeat.

Consolidate resource and supervision policy through existing processcontrol, driver and gate owners. Prove CPU work holds no GPU lease; correctness users coexist; an exclusive measurement child is never blocked by an ancestor's shared lease; publication holds only its write transaction; process/child death releases ownership. Never infer abandonment from heartbeat age or process names. Preserve physical identity across stores/worktrees, bounded waiting, cancellation causes and task-completion resource output. No second package-ownership list, wait loop, launcher or recovery state machine.

Only after these proofs, integrate implemented/checkpointed, verified and promoted transitions through the existing gate. Test refusal with outstanding checks; exact source/index/HEAD and immutable lineage; restart/replan without orphaned obligations; mandatory escalation; final full integration; elapsed-only flush with no new checkpoint; trailing obligations; exact boundaries and empty/negative/overflow/pre-origin refusal. Keep BatchFlush.Advance as the transition owner; no duplicate accumulator or reset authority. Privatize gate-only cost helpers and remove displaced callers atomically. Retain reviewed exclusions from prior lane intakes; no open lane plan or previously refused policy is implicitly imported.

Measure cold and resumed runs on the same representative change matrix, including an evidence-only E4B selection, a test change, fixture/runtime input change, kernel and gate-policy change. Report full wall, wait, acquisition, checks, publication, repeated loads, package reuse, outstanding obligations and operator interventions; do not equate summed phase time with elapsed savings. Require reduced repeated work/intervention with identical regression detection; otherwise keep the old policy. The E4B 935.2-second gate executed 234 packages with zero package reuse after a 97.1-second database-lock failure: use that incident to drive a controlled counterexample, not a universal performance threshold.

Retained open incident authorities (closure requires their own evidence): evidence:sha256:0f4b6d07607b3fa8ee6ee7f320646e5dbbd5b38b025a19c2046d54aed7fa4b4e, evidence:sha256:13a4473eab084e75be2c92ffc5bb6a8544fe78e3c6edd04abf2dd3a8c3be00db, evidence:sha256:42f5196b3d02c67f3de8e67ee22f5bcbde3e4673e6d6059e2c052900def5dfc5, evidence:sha256:5907e3a581c7ee0151f63a42454a0b576b90735054c1969518d410e07f944795.

verification_batch.rationale: One existing-owner process-control integration, subdivided into bounded acceptance checkpoints. Inspect existing resource and persistence owners before editing; explicitly amend scope if another owner is required. Existing bound tests remain lower bounds. New named tests below are implementation obligations, not claims that these capabilities already pass. Migrate cmd/test-lane with the shared streaming evidence contract; it is an existing consumer, not a new test runner.
verification_batch.reopen_when: Cumulative source, transitive dependencies, fixtures, resolved environment, resource identity, required acceptance or scope changes invalidate the affected evidence and reopen durable obligations. Checkpoints never complete the parent.

items.title: Declare the denominator and validate existing modality capabilities

steps.title: Publish and accept the complete E4B evidence bundle from clean source
steps.rationale:
Finish E4B before starting another model, using one integrated model acceptance. Preserve language tensor-set:sha256:cd4ada4703c2b76a84a10da94f09b9199b6d4dad7e3dcabbe79d8cee745f4501 and projector tensor-set:sha256:185786ec6d77c31f87e6ebdcf8a0d095dbb7175999122229f8e82dcdad25004e, with logical projector fd74ad68955dc65da2ccd2498b6ae39b05685120d2cc9ed1bd3c41f4c9933686. Reuse the shared CPU/projected transcription evaluator and bounded, identity-verified audio reader; do not recreate input materialization or another inference runtime.

The acceptance denominator is six input modes (text, image, multi-image, audio, ordered video, mixed history) across native completion, Chat and Responses: 18 request cells. Exact prompt IDs and complete native FP32/SDPA and BF16/SDPA outputs are lower-bound protocol evidence. The landed audio test produces 16/16 complete native matches over 8 of 2703 validation clips, WER 0.056338028169014086 and CER 0.046875, plus truncation refusal. These known validation cases are neither held-out quality nor full E4B completion. Preserve the original blight/plight counterexample and native precision differences; do not tune arithmetic merely to erase instruction-model behavior. Eager-attention captures remain diagnostic.

First resolve the canonical audio publication failure: the preparation reused the dataset source inventory shard as the evaluation split, making a lineage cycle before inference. Derive a separate selected-split artifact from exact container, physical row and payload identities. Validation dataset:sha256:39b4aa4872600afff4be0633dc066adfe5ae36ac17ade4a6ac4a16e26852b2e3 and held-out dataset:sha256:ad4177fe91ec6ce5ffd1299905164d50672d09d08d5d44fdcb4b36430900b1d7 are distinct. Publish the frozen eight-case validation score from clean source. Then freeze 32 evenly spaced held-out rows floor(i*2619/31), i=0..31, with no replacements, original source identities, declared prompt, greedy decoding, thinking disabled and 256-token cap. Derive per-case and aggregate WER/CER bounds from matched native FP32/BF16 SDPA references before evaluating Go. Require complete termination for all 32; repeated timing uses one warmup and three measured rounds under isolated resource ownership. A budget interruption leaves the denominator incomplete.

Query the registered catalog and C:/Users/jeffm/overgo/datasets for appropriate image/text/video labels and available assets. The prior inventory had 84 entries, 47 available and 37 unavailable; refresh it rather than treating those counts as current truth. Find/acquire missing required assets and register unregistered datasets through existing owners. VidGen dataset:sha256:4777bc1b93f015535b2495200272095ad2d01d9cfc3bfffe14800765f736daf5 may supply present captioned clips, with its generation-training origin explicit. Freeze suitable understanding oracles and physical-case denominators; extension-only modality tags and nonempty outputs do not establish quality. Keep parity-only and dataset-backed quality separate.

Retain 32768-token capacity and repeated grow/shrink/cancel/error/reload/non-growth checks as text-resource evidence; they do not establish projector-resource acceptance. Bind media cleanup, mixed-history ownership, full-output quality and resource behavior before final acceptance. Reuse historical fixed-budget controls and long-form records only after an exact source/surface and protocol independence check; the raw-continuation ladder alone does not satisfy the three fixed-budget controls. Republish invalidated admission at the current surface. Keep failed before measurements and thresholds unchanged.

Implement TestAcceptedE4BModalities in the existing compatibility owner as the final read-only join: reject any missing modality, protocol, task-quality assertion, source identity, completion denominator, resource check or unpromoted required binding. Store one evidence bundle for the model, then feed existing memory/benchmark/modality reports from those same records. Run the batch once at integration after related changes; scoped diagnostics during implementation are not completion. Master owns validation and numerical/admission repairs; GUI owns HTTP implementation, audio owns native streaming and training. No projector promotion until all declared media modes have evidence.

The producer prerequisite owns the CPU/GPU integration batch and the read-only final assertion. This row performs the clean-source measurement and evidence-binding phase: reuse exact proven-independent protocol/resource records, acquire missing or invalidated cells, then run the final read-only acceptance once. Do not repeat the producer batch for every record or report update. If measurement exposes a new runtime defect, stop affected measurement, retain the failed record, and bind one new coherent repair producer before resuming clean-source publication; never reopen a completed identity or waive source cleanliness. Other models and aggregate reports consume the same completed bundle.
